grid.pixelRegistration: area; pixel centres at half-pixel offsets
grid.radiusMeaning: Web Mercator horizontal projection parameter; not a height datum

verticalReference.description: Source-specific heights preserved; no uniform geoid, ellipsoid or reference-sphere datum established by the archive metadata.

coverage.missingTiles: absent, never implicitly flat or measured ocean
coverage.zeroValues: valid encoded upstream zeros; may include upstream nodata fill and ocean; no recoverable measurement mask
coverage.polarCoverage: No coverage outside Web Mercator bounds; bounds within them do not establish measurements

derivation.split: z+1, 2x+dx, 2y+dy; dy=0 north, dx=0 west; exact scalar samples
derivation.zoom0: 2 by 2 arithmetic mean of decoded source z0 heights in projected pixel space; float64; nearest-even Terrarium rounding

plan.scope: Exact declared source windows and ancestors; absent entries stay absent. Transfer budget includes PMTiles directories and payloads.

limitations: ETag binds the server version, not a full-archive cryptographic checksum.
Only the declared footprint is retained; this is not a complete global source snapshot.
Upstream vertical reference is unresolved and encoded zero may include upstream no-data fill.

consumerCompatibility: Separate experimental contract. elevation-xyz v2 requires reference-sphere heights and XYZ URLs; do not relabel this archive as that contract.
